integrity: The proof reduces the complete n-variable quadratic idempotent equations to a common monic quadratic and a two-value disjoint-subset count. Singular adjacency characteristics are handled separately. Independent finite-field enumeration is a replay check, not a proof in all dimensions.
scientific_limitations: Odd characteristic and dimension at least three; characteristic two is excluded.
Counts concern individual idempotent vectors, not isomorphism classes of evolution algebras or automorphism orbits.
The point-counting zeta function does not certify reducedness or smoothness of the original solution scheme.
Equivalent results under genetic quadratic-map terminology may exist outside the searches performed.
title: Idempotent-point counts for complete-graph evolution algebras
